items.title: How did Republicans lose so badly in North Carolina?
items.summary: Republicans suffered sweeping losses across the US in the midterm elections, but perhaps nowhere as large as here Republicans suffered sweeping losses across the country in the midterm elections, but perhaps nowhere as large as North Carolina . Democrats flipped a US Senate seat for the first time since 2008, as well as five House seats, one of which Cook Political Report had rated “solid” Republican, and four others considered “likely” Republican. Democrats also held power in the state’s first district, which Republicans had targeted in a redistricting effort . Continue reading...
